name: gavel-onchain-verdict
description: Gavel, an onchain AI court powered by Somnia Agents.

scripts.build: npm run contracts:compile && npm run frontend:build
scripts.contracts:test: npm run test:v2 && npm run test:v1
scripts.test:v2: cross-env APPDATA=.hardhat-home LOCALAPPDATA=.hardhat-home hardhat test test/DisputeEscrowV2.test.js
scripts.test:v1: cross-env APPDATA=.hardhat-home LOCALAPPDATA=.hardhat-home hardhat test test/DisputeEscrow.test.js
scripts.deploy:somnia: cross-env APPDATA=.hardhat-home LOCALAPPDATA=.hardhat-home hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network somniaTestnet
scripts.verify:somnia: cross-env APPDATA=.hardhat-home LOCALAPPDATA=.hardhat-home hardhat run scripts/verify.js --network somniaTestnet
scripts.proof:somnia: cross-env APPDATA=.hardhat-home LOCALAPPDATA=.hardhat-home hardhat run scripts/live-proof-v2.js --network somniaTestnet
scripts.check:bytecode: cross-env APPDATA=.hardhat-home LOCALAPPDATA=.hardhat-home hardhat run scripts/check-bytecode.js --network somniaTestnet
scripts.test: npm run contracts:test && npm run frontend:build
